notes: Dropped the 'negative_wrong_emoji' insertion. Under the assigned route, the focal selector qualifies a reaction solely by whether the reacted-to message's author holds the admin role in T01WORKSPACE; it does not (and cannot, without presupposing the answer) filter by reaction_type. Consequently any additional reaction placed on the same admin-authored message (e.g. a 'thumbsup' from U01AGENBOT9 on Robert's message) is mechanically indistinguishable from a legitimate match and would always be swept into the selector's output, making it impossible to realize as a true excluded negative under this route/selector — it is a structural limitation of the underspecified-authorship-only filter, not a seeding error. All other design elements are preserved: two admins (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman) each have exactly one qualifying admin-authored message with exactly one 'eyes' reaction, yielding the intended two-way underspecified answer set {reaction_robert_eyes, reaction_morgan_eyes}. negative_nonadmin_author and negative_admin_as_reactor remain valid, selector-excluded negatives (author not admin, or admin is reactor rather than author, respectively), together with the pre-existing base reaction on message 1706110000.000100 (authored by non-admin U_LUKAS), which the selector also correctly excludes. Solving requires only conversations.history/read access on C01ABCD1234 and C03IJKL9012, both already broadly populated in channel_members, plus users.list-scoped workspace role visibility; no cross-workspace access is required.
